exposure: Percutaneous endoscopic gastrostomy (PEG) procedure in childhood
outcome: Re-opening and symptomatic presentation of a previously closed gastrocutaneous fistula
cohort: A 34-year-old woman who had a PEG procedure at age four due to caustic esophageal injury.
finding: A gastrocutaneous fistula that spontaneously closed after a PEG procedure in childhood can become symptomatic and reopen during pregnancy, requiring surgical repair after delivery.
